description: Create a pac authentication profile. Non-interactive: service principal (applicationId + clientSecret + tenant), certificate, managed identity, or GitHub / Azure DevOps federation. Interactive (a person signing in, which is the usual way to add an admin account): pass name, environment and background: true - pac opens its own browser, the call returns a jobId at once, and cs_job_status reports when the profile exists. Without background this blocks until the sign-in finishes and the client will usually give up first. Device code needs a terminal: this server gives pac no stdin. Runs 'pac auth create' with the active pac auth profile.

azureDevOpsFederated.description: Azure DevOps federated credential (needs tenant and applicationId)

background.description: Run in the background and return a jobId immediately. Use this for interactive sign-in: pac opens a browser and waits, which would otherwise outlive the client's call timeout. Poll cs_job_status.

certificatePassword.description: Certificate password (masked in logs) (masked in logs and results)

clientSecret.description: Client secret (masked in logs) (masked in logs and results)

cloud.description: Cloud instance (Public, UsGov, UsGovHigh, UsGovDod, China)

cwd.description: Working directory for pac (for project commands: the solution project folder)

deviceCode.description: Use the device-code flow for interactive sign-in (blocks until done)

environment.description: Default environment for the profile (id, URL, unique or partial name)

githubFederated.description: GitHub federated credential (needs tenant and applicationId)

password.description: Password (masked in logs) (masked in logs and results)

profile.description: pac auth profile to run as: the admin account for tenant commands. Defaults to CPS_ADMIN_PROFILE for admin commands and CPS_PAC_PROFILE otherwise, then the active profile. cs_init lists the profiles.

username.description: User name for username/password auth (not recommended)

name: cs_create_auth_profile
title: Create a pac auth profile
